executive_summary.summary: Composes 9 FRs with their NFRs; never-acquiring-FBO-status is the top constraint; 6 NFR TBDs and 2 coverage gaps remain.
executive_summary.reasoning: Condenses the requirement count, the single biggest constraint (never acquiring FBO status), and the open-question count — every claim already appears in the sections below. Written last.

compound_splits.source_clause_summary: Pilot launch with a capped cohort AND transaction limits scaled to completeness — vision.md Roadmap Phase 3

assumptions.short_title: Facilitation-only structure will hold up to validation
assumptions.summary: Vision's facilitation-only legal/product structure hasn't been validated yet, though FR-001/FR-006 assume it will hold.
assumptions.reasoning: vision.md's Roadmap calls for validating this structure with a design partner or legal counsel, but that hasn't happened — FR-001 and FR-006 are written as if it already holds.

assumptions.short_title: Producers and distributors have sufficient digital access
assumptions.summary: Attestation, dual sign-off, and allergen declaration all assume reliable on-platform digital access for producers/distributors.
assumptions.reasoning: None of the three FRs' digital workflows were validated against the target segment's actual digital access; carried as an unvalidated premise, not a confirmed fact.

assumptions.short_title: Buyers will trust the displayed completeness score without independent audit
assumptions.summary: Buyer discovery assumes foodservice buyers will act on the completeness score directly, without independent verification.
assumptions.reasoning: FR-002 surfaces a completeness score for discovery, but nothing in vision.md or requirements.md confirms buyers will accept it without their own audit.

assumptions.short_title: Pilot cohort will be selected and onboarded manually
assumptions.summary: The cohort-eligibility gate assumes product/operations will designate eligible producers/distributors by hand.
assumptions.reasoning: FR-007 restricts trading to a designated cohort but never specifies a self-service application flow, so manual designation is the working assumption.

constraints.short_title: Must never acquire Food Business Operator status
constraints.summary: HarvestLink must operate strictly as a data/matching and documentation layer; producers/distributors remain the FBOs.
constraints.reasoning: Carried forward from vision.md § Regulatory Posture's Red CON-01 item — the single hardest limit shaping FR-001 and FR-006's design.

constraints.short_title: Traceability records require dual sign-off and immutability
constraints.summary: Producer and distributor dual sign-off with an immutable audit log is not solved by default; must be explicitly designed for.
constraints.reasoning: Carried forward from vision.md § Regulatory Posture's Amber CON-02 item, which constrains exactly how FR-003 must be built.

constraints.short_title: Allergen declarations require producer attestation before finalisation
constraints.summary: Producer attestation and sign-off is required before any allergen declaration is finalised on-platform.
constraints.reasoning: Carried forward from vision.md § Regulatory Posture's Amber CON-03 item, which constrains FR-004's workflow directly.

constraints.short_title: Pilot phase is scoped to a designated cohort, not general availability
constraints.summary: Limits scale with completeness data only after pilot; general availability is explicitly out of scope for this PRD.
constraints.reasoning: Carried forward from vision.md § Roadmap Outline, Phase 3 — the pilot scoping bounds what FR-005 and FR-007 are allowed to do right now.

constraints.short_title: Data protection remains an ongoing design/monitoring requirement
constraints.summary: Not a launch blocker, but every component surfacing or reporting on user/producer data must keep this in view.
constraints.reasoning: Carried forward from vision.md § Regulatory Posture's Green item — lower urgency than the Red/Amber items but still a real, ongoing limit on FR-002/FR-008/FR-009.

risks.summary: The entire roadmap depends on this legal/product structure; no fallback path is defined if it can't fully avoid FBO status.
risks.reasoning: Carried forward verbatim from vision.md § Open Risks Carried Forward (OR-01) — unchanged since no new information has resolved it at requirement level.

risks.summary: Dual-sign-off and completeness-scoring is a design commitment, not yet a selected or validated methodology.
risks.reasoning: Carried forward verbatim from vision.md § Open Risks Carried Forward (OR-02) — affects every FR that depends on the completeness score being accurate.

risks.summary: A wholesaler could bundle a producer-marketplace feature into existing compliance infra before pilot launch.
risks.reasoning: Carried forward verbatim from vision.md § Open Risks Carried Forward (OR-03) — a market-timing risk that doesn't map to any single requirement, so tagged program-level rather than forcing a false FR tag.

requirements.title: Facilitation-only role attestation at onboarding
requirements.statement: The system shall require every onboarding producer or distributor to explicitly attest that they, not HarvestLink, hold Food Business Operator status for any trade facilitated on the platform.

nfrs.boundary_condition: Attestation must be a clear, explicit step, not a buried checkbox
Attestation must be tied to an authenticated producer/distributor identity
Retain 6 years from creation, per Group Records Retention Policy

requirements.reasoning: Carried verbatim from requirements.md FR-001, with all 3 nfr-spec.md boundary conditions attached — none dropped.

requirements.title: Foodservice buyer discovery and matching
requirements.statement: The system shall allow foodservice buyers to discover onboarded producers and distributors by product category, location, and compliance-documentation completeness score.

nfrs.boundary_condition: Search results must show compliance-documentation completeness score alongside each producer
Buyer search/discovery response time — TBD — needs stakeholder input

requirements.reasoning: Carried verbatim from requirements.md FR-002, with both nfr-spec.md boundary conditions attached, including the still-open Performance TBD.

requirements.title: Dual sign-off traceability record entry
requirements.statement: The system shall require both producer and distributor sign-off before a traceability record is finalised, and shall retain every finalised record in an immutable, append-only audit log.
requirements.traces_to: vision.md § Regulatory Posture (traceability mitigation: producer and distributor dual sign-off, immutable audit log)

nfrs.boundary_condition: Traceability record must be immutable (append-only) once dual-signed
Must satisfy Reg. (EC) 178/2002 Art. 18 "one step back, one step forward"
99.9% uptime — traceability records may be required for active regulatory defence

requirements.reasoning: Carried verbatim from requirements.md FR-003, with all 3 nfr-spec.md boundary conditions attached — none dropped.

requirements.title: Producer-attested allergen declaration workflow
requirements.statement: The system shall require producer attestation and sign-off before an allergen declaration is finalised on-platform.
requirements.traces_to: vision.md § Regulatory Posture (allergen mitigation: producer attestation and sign-off before finalisation)

nfrs.boundary_condition: Must satisfy Natasha's Law / EU FIC Reg. 1169/2011 baseline labelling
Producer must see a clear pending/finalised state distinction for each declaration
Expected declaration volume — TBD — needs stakeholder input

requirements.reasoning: Carried verbatim from requirements.md FR-004, with all 3 nfr-spec.md boundary conditions attached, including the still-open Scalability TBD.

requirements.title: Compliance-completeness-scaled transaction limits
requirements.statement: The system shall set a producer's maximum transaction value according to their compliance-documentation completeness score, and re-evaluate that limit as the score changes.
requirements.traces_to: vision.md § Roadmap Outline, Phase 3 (split — see Compound Requirements Split above)

nfrs.boundary_condition: Transaction-value limit must be enforced server-side; not client-configurable
Limit recalculation frequency on completeness-score change — TBD — needs stakeholder input

requirements.reasoning: Carried verbatim from requirements.md FR-005 (a compound-split half), with both nfr-spec.md boundary conditions attached, including the still-open Performance TBD.

requirements.title: Facilitation-only transaction routing
requirements.statement: The system shall never record HarvestLink as taking possession, title, or physical custody of food in any transaction; every trade shall be routed and documented as a direct producer/distributor-to-buyer arrangement.
requirements.traces_to: vision.md § Regulatory Posture (FBO-status mitigation: HarvestLink never takes physical possession of food)

nfrs.boundary_condition: Must never record HarvestLink as taking title/possession of goods in any transaction record
Behaviour if a trade cannot be routed facilitation-only — TBD — needs stakeholder input

requirements.reasoning: Carried verbatim from requirements.md FR-006, with both nfr-spec.md boundary conditions attached, including the still-open Availability TBD.

requirements.title: Pilot-phase cohort restriction
requirements.statement: The system shall restrict onboarding and trading, during the pilot phase, to a cohort of producers/distributors explicitly designated eligible by the product/operations team.
requirements.traces_to: vision.md § Roadmap Outline, Phase 3 (split — see Compound Requirements Split above)

nfrs.boundary_condition: Non-cohort users must receive an explicit "not yet available" response, not a silent failure
Target cohort size for pilot — TBD — needs stakeholder input

requirements.reasoning: Carried verbatim from requirements.md FR-007 (the other compound-split half), with both nfr-spec.md boundary conditions attached, including the still-open Scalability TBD.

requirements.title: Time-to-first-compliant-trade measurement
requirements.statement: The system shall record, per producer, the elapsed time from onboarding start to first fully-documented, compliance-complete trade, and expose this for reporting against a target of under 14 days.

nfrs.boundary_condition: P95 time-to-first-compliant-trade < 14 days (onboarding start → first compliance-complete trade)
Best-effort (outbound-only reporting feed, not a compliance record)

requirements.reasoning: Carried verbatim from requirements.md FR-008, with both nfr-spec.md boundary conditions attached — none dropped.

requirements.title: Compliance-documentation-completeness measurement
requirements.statement: The system shall record, per producer, a compliance-documentation completeness score at first trade, and expose this for reporting against a target of at least 95%.

nfrs.boundary_condition: Reported compliance-documentation completeness score ≥ 95% at first trade
Whether specific buyer names may appear in completeness reporting — TBD — needs stakeholder input

requirements.reasoning: Carried verbatim from requirements.md FR-009, with both nfr-spec.md boundary conditions attached, including the still-open Compliance TBD.

open_questions.summary: Limit recalculation frequency on completeness-score change
Behaviour if a trade cannot be routed facilitation-only
Whether specific buyer names may appear in completeness reporting
No FR covers producer/distributor offboarding or suspension — only onboarding (FR-001) and ongoing trading are specified.
No FR covers dispute handling when a buyer contests a delivered trade's compliance documentation after FR-003's dual sign-off.

content.execution_summary:
• Produced 9 composed requirements (FR-001–FR-009), 4 assumptions, 5 constraints, 3 risks, 8 open questions (6 TBD + 2 coverage gaps).
• Key decision: OR-03 (competitive response speed) tagged program-level — it doesn't map to any single FR, so no false tag was forced. CON-01 (Red) split across FR-001/FR-006 since the regulatory mitigation names two distinct mechanisms (attestation and routing).
• Composing FR+NFR side by side surfaced 2 requirement-coverage gaps (offboarding/suspension, dispute handling) invisible in requirements.md or nfr-spec.md alone.
• Reflection: FR count (9) exactly matches requirements.md; all NFR boundary conditions preserved across all 9 FRs; every assumption/constraint/risk tagged to an FR or program-level; no success-metrics field added.
• Knowledge bases consulted: none.
• Guardrails evaluated: gr-L1-output-schema-validator (pass), gr-L1-pii-detection (pass), gr-L1-hallucination-check (pass), gr-L1-consistency-check (pass).
• Tools invoked: none — requirements.md's header (Approval consumed) retrieved directly from its s3 artifact.
• s3 location: s3://adlc-artifacts/exec-2d7c94ab/prd.md.
• Gaps flagged: 6 NFR TBDs and 2 coverage gaps, all listed in open_questions.
